identity_header.policy: filled event-specific values may anchor identity; unrelated administrative fields are not repair knowledge

special_notes.policy: preserve the complete Special Notes section; printed boilerplate is template context only; event-specific handwriting or typed additions require human review

repairs_replacements.boundary_policy: the printed table grid network in the original Traveler defines the evidence region; semantic vertical rules establish the full left/right span and repeated horizontal-rule coverage establishes top/bottom; handwriting extent and fixed expansion never define the final crop
repairs_replacements.content_policy: meaningful filled-in description content is preserved even without a repaired/replaced mark; repaired/replaced marks are attributes of content, not admission gates

global_ignores.policy: retain for raw/audit only; never testing evidence, final-result evidence, initials/date evidence, terminology evidence, association signal, or Qdrant knowledge
